per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to user interactions within 5 seconds to avoid user frustration and distractions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI should be consistent with other internal tools in terms of menus, buttons, fonts, and icons.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should use color-coded statuses to indicate the state of cases, with additional visual indicators for color-blind users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow users to save and persist their preferred views, including column filters and sorting options.
The system should display clear and actionable error messages that guide users on how to proceed when errors occur.
The system should be available outside of normal business hours to accommodate cardmember and merchant requests.
The system should have predictable maintenance windows, preferably during early morning hours or Sundays, with advance notifications.
The system should support draft saving when lookups fail or data is incomplete, allowing users to return to the case later.
The system should be able to handle peak concurrent usage of approximately 350 users without significant performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should implement role-based access control to restrict certain high-risk or chargeback cases from being filed by new representatives without approval.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should maintain an audit log that records who made changes, when they were made, and what was changed, including both old and new values.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should integrate with authoritative data sources such as the statement system, cardmember database, and merchant database for accurate and up-to-date information.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear error handling and warnings when integrations with backend systems fail, allowing users to continue with cached or partial data.
The system should retain case histories and audit trails for long-term compliance, with the ability to export data for audits.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide a legend or tooltip for color-coded statuses to assist color-blind users and new representatives.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow users to create and submit cases in a read-only or draft mode during maintenance windows or outages.
The system should provide clear notifications and alerts for errors, failed lookups, and system issues, with appropriate messaging levels.
